typed_interfaces.crossGram: noncomputable def crossGram : {n l m : Nat} -> Chain n l 1 -> Chain n m 1 -> Matrix (Fin l) (Fin m) Real; nil/nil returns1; cons A C/cons B D returns sum bit:Fin2, slice A bit * crossGram C D * (slice B bit).transpose
typed_interfaces.ttVector: noncomputable def ttVector {n:Nat} (C:Chain n 1 1) : EuclideanSpace Real (Word n) := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun x => contract C x 0 0)
typed_interfaces.crossGram_eq_sum: theorem crossGram_eq_sum {n l m:Nat} (C:Chain n l 1) (D:Chain n m 1) : crossGram C D = sum x:Word n, contract C x * (contract D x).transpose
typed_interfaces.crossGram_scalar: theorem crossGram_scalar {n:Nat} (C D:Chain n 1 1) : crossGram C D 0 0 = sum x:Word n, contract C x 0 0 * contract D x 0 0
typed_interfaces.gram_vector_norm_sq: theorem gram_vector_norm_sq {n:Nat} (C:Chain n 1 1) : TensorTrainNormEnvironment.gram C 0 0 = norm(ttVector C)^2
typed_interfaces.residual_identity: theorem residual_identity {n:Nat} (C D:Chain n 1 1) (s:Real) : norm(ttVector D - s^(-1) smul ttVector C)^2 = TensorTrainNormEnvironment.gram D 0 0 - 2*s^(-1)*crossGram C D 0 0 + (s^(-1))^2*TensorTrainNormEnvironment.gram C 0 0
typed_interfaces.certificate_to_normalized: theorem certificate_to_normalized {n:Nat} (C D:Chain n 1 1) {s r tau:Real} (hs:0<s) (hr:0<=r) (raw_positive:0<TensorTrainNormEnvironment.gram C 0 0) (residual:TensorTrainNormEnvironment.gram D 0 0 - 2*s^(-1)*crossGram C D 0 0 + (s^(-1))^2*TensorTrainNormEnvironment.gram C 0 0<=r^2) (norm_square_error:abs((s^(-1))^2*TensorTrainNormEnvironment.gram C 0 0-1)<=tau) : norm(ttVector D-NormedSpace.normalize(ttVector C))<=r+tau
typed_interfaces.crossUpdateBudget_le: theorem crossUpdateBudget_le (lC mC lD mD B:Nat) (hlC:lC<=B) (hmC:mC<=B) (hlD:lD<=B) (hmD:mD<=B) : crossUpdateBudget lC mC lD mD<=9*B^3
typed_interfaces.crossArithmeticBudget: def crossArithmeticBudget : {n l m:Nat}->Chain n l 1->Chain n m 1->Nat; nil/nil0; cons/cons charges crossUpdateBudget current left/right dimensions plus recursive tail budget
typed_interfaces.crossArithmeticBudget_le: theorem crossArithmeticBudget_le {n l m:Nat} (C:Chain n l 1) (D:Chain n m 1) (B:Nat) (hC:maxBond C<=B) (hD:maxBond D<=B) : crossArithmeticBudget C D<=9*n*B^3
typed_interfaces.certificateArithmeticBudget: def certificateArithmeticBudget {n:Nat} (C D:Chain n 1 1):Nat := crossArithmeticBudget C C+crossArithmeticBudget D D+crossArithmeticBudget C D

execution_contract.stored_domain: Nonempty real finite float64 TT with scalar open boundaries and compatible positive bond dimensions. Copy/interpret every actual stored entry via Fraction.from_float. Reject complex/nonfinite/malformed entries; retain the frozen canonicalizer's honest zero/underflow failures.
execution_contract.actual_producer: Call frozen scaled_right_canonicalize exactly once. Bind that same returned TT and ScaledNorm; no replacement producer or dense amplitude input. Encode s exactly as Fraction.from_float(mantissa)*2^exponent, not to_float, log_norm or an ideal product of removed factors.
execution_contract.certificate: Compute exact raw/raw, output/output and raw/output local cross-Gram contractions. Form q=Gout-2*cross/s+Graw/s^2 and a2=Graw/s^2. Reject q<0 or Graw<=0. Compute rational r>=sqrt(q) by integer square-root rounding upward on a requested binary grid and verify r^2>=q exactly. tau=abs(a2-1). Return r+tau for the literal output versus normalized original stored TT.
execution_contract.refinement_boundary: The Lean cross-Gram theorem certifies the literal local mathematical recursion. Exact Python Fraction loops mirror it; no whole interpreter/numpy/serialization refinement is claimed. No local QR trace is required because the residual measures the actual end-to-end stored return, including rescaling, QR, absorption, head normalization and rounded scale product.
execution_contract.diagnostics_only: Small dense signed references may test the certificate, never enter the producer. Wide tests contract selected amplitudes or no amplitudes. Rank-deficient/zero/tall/tiny and huge-scale cases must distinguish successful certificates from honest producer failure.

cost_model.contraction: Three local Gram passes, matrix-multiply schedule: at most27*n*B^3 field additions/multiplications when both actual trains' bonds<=B. Input float decoding, scalar assembly, division, integer sqrt, allocation/copies/comparisons and exact rational normalization/GCD are separately charged, not free matrix callbacks.
cost_model.actual_counters: Count all exact rational multiplications/additions in matrix products and bit-environment sum; record actual visited core/scalar dimensions and maximum intermediate numerator/denominator bit lengths. No 2^n enumeration, full amplitude table, SVD or exact rank test in producer.
cost_model.finite_bit: Fraction arithmetic is exact finite integer arithmetic, not unit cost. Measure operand growth, requested binary grid, mantissa/exponent materialization and certificate text. A polynomial field-operation count does not certify a uniform polynomial bit/runtime theorem.
cost_model.normalizer: Actual exponent expansion may create large integers; charge abs(exponent) and resulting bit lengths. Never use floating normalizer expansion as a correctness step.
cost_model.remaining: Scalar/source conversion delta, exact Python-to-Lean adapter, all intermediate uniform bit bounds, actual angle/serialization zeta, epsilon-dependent source/QR/backend acceptance and all-garbage circuit composition remain open.
